(shiver-app-overview)=
# Overview of the SHeffield Ice Velocity ExploreR application

The [SHIVER application](https://shiver-ice-velocity.github.io/SHIVER/) is a tool that allows interactive exploration and extraction of ice velocity data from the Unified Dataset. It is designed to be useable for non-specialists whilst still providing sufficient flexibility and robustness to support scientific applications. Of course, no single set of filters is perfect for every application, so the data presented in the application are not entirely free of outliers. So if you want to use the Unified Dataset for your science, we would encourage you to design your own routines that ingest the SHIVER output and perform filtering and analysis suitable for your investigation.

The SHIVER application provides two ways to query the Unified Dataset, both based on an interactive map of Greenland and Antarctica.
1. **The Timeseries Explorer**: simply click on the map to extract a timeseries. This tool is designed to support data exploration and is suitable for teaching.
2. **The Data Cube Extractor**: simply draw a polygon on the map and choose your parameters to extract a NetCDF of velocity data. This tool is designed for scientists who want to conduct their own analysis on a subset of the Unified Dataset without requiring access to the Cloud. 

The following pages provide detailed documentation of these two Graphical User Interfaces for the data.
